content.comment_body: Hello, I've encountered an issue while trying to download a program to the device. After setting up the connection successfully, I attempted to proceed but received an error message with no further details in the info window. Any assistance to resolve this would be appreciated. Thank you.
Could you explain how you fixed the problem?

Hello [user_name], Please review the screenshot in the earlier post. The error message indicates that some blocks lack connections to outputs. The specific blocks mentioned are: - B011 - B024 - B030 While the program works fine in simulation, it cannot be transferred to the [product_name] device. To address open outputs in digital blocks, you can: - Link the open output to another block's input - Attach the open output to an open connector - Connect the open output to a digital output - Assign the open output to a digital flag
I’ve included a screen recording in the attachment.
Hope you're doing well. Could you share how you resolved the issue? Thank you.

Welcome. The solution was provided earlier, though it may not apply to every scenario. Please feel free to describe your particular situation to the forum. Adding an image or a sample of your program could be helpful. The more information you share, the better the volunteers here can assist you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report receiving a vague error when trying to download programs to a [company_name] [product_name] device, even after successful connection configuration. The error specifies blocks lacking connections to outputs but provides no actionable suggestions. Simulation runs without issues, but downloads fail, leading to user confusion when program transfer does not match simulation outcomes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and helpful error messages with troubleshooting guidance for failed downloads to [product_name] devices. They also anticipate that simulation checks should align with actual download requirements.
